contract.description: Load the agent startup brief in one call - persona, top-scored facts, recent journal and the tombstone digest - instead of chaining memory_persona_get, memory_recall and memory_list at session start. Sections fill in priority order (persona, facts, tombstones, journal) under a total char budget; chars are the size proxy, not exact tokens, and a section that no longer fits is named in omitted - truncation is never silent. Journal bodies are capped per entry and flagged truncated; tombstones are references only, inspect one via memory_list status=Tombstoned. A section in state empty means cold start: nothing recorded there yet, not a failure - when every section comes back empty the response says so and points at memory_scry for cross-tome context. The brief is scoped to one tome; pass tome to brief another tome you own. upstream_unavailable means the store or embedding provider is unreachable; the call is read-only and writes nothing.
contract.name: memory_brief
contract.title: Get the startup brief
